scoring_justification: The agent's artifact is a CSV of S_x and S_y at various carrier densities. The checker recomputes mean absolute relative error against hidden reference values derived from the paper's theoretical Seebeck coefficient curves (digitized from Figs. 3d and 4b and approximated by a linear-in-log model). This is T1 because we recompute an error metric from the agent's raw output points, not simply compare a self-reported scalar. The error metric is then scored against a threshold with monotonic decay.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference Seebeck coefficients S_x and S_y for bulk, 5L, 2L, 1L BP as function of carrier density. These values are derived by digitizing the theoretical curves in the paper's Fig. 3d and Fig. 4b, then fitting a simple logarithmic-linear model S = S0 - slope * (log10(n) - 17). The parameters are chosen to match the behavior shown in the figures.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figures 3d and 4b, digitized and approximated by linear-in-log model.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Visual digitization of theoretical curves and fitting. The model parameters are recorded inline.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The reference values reflect the paper's published computational results, not arbitrary constants. The model captures the monotonic decrease of S with increasing carrier density and the quantitative range reported in the paper (max S ~510 μV/K at low density for bulk, ~600 μV/K for monolayer).

outputs.description: Computed Seebeck coefficient components as a function of volumetric carrier density for bulk and few-layer black phosphorus at T=210 K. Must include rows for each of the following carrier density values (cm^{-3}): 1e17, 2e17, 5e17, 1e18, 2e18, 5e18, 1e19, 2e19, 5e19, 1e20, 2e20, 5e20, 1e21, for each layer system (bulk, 5L, 2L, 1L).

output_contract.notes: The artifact is scored by comparing the agent's computed S_x and S_y values at selected carrier densities against the paper's theoretical reference curves.

steps.description: Scoring Seebeck coefficient vs carrier density using mean absolute relative error against hidden reference values.
